id: RIVERS OF NIHIL - NZ TOUR-Valhalla, Wellington-Valhalla
name: RIVERS OF NIHIL - NZ TOUR
long_description:
Pennsylvanias progressive death metal progenitors Rivers of Nihil make their first voyage to Aotearoa New Zealand.

The quartets musicianship has been honed to a fine point thanks to an unrelenting touring schedule over the past few years, including headline tours of the U.S. and EU/UK, as well as touring with Cattle Decapitation, Carnifex, Lorna Shore, Between the Buried and Me, and touring with titans of progressive death metal Cynic, Beyond Creation, and Dååth.

Life on the road for Rivers is a treat for fans and band members alike. For the most part, its very mellow, with a lot of laughs and a lot of ball-busting. Andy (Guitar, Vocals), and I have been friends for over 15 years, and Jared (Drums) has been in the fold since 2017 says founding member/guitarist Brody Uttley. Founding bassist Adam Biggs became the bands new lead vocalist/bassist in 2023, which upped the ante and led to the release of self-titled album Rivers of Nihil (2025). Traditionally, a self-titled record can signal a return to basics and/or a fresh beginning, and in 10 powerful songs, its clear that both those factors are in play. I feel like these songs are the perfect blend of all our albums, with all the fat cut away, says Uttley.

River of Nihil have riffs, big choruses, the prog, the solos, the sax and now it will have Aotearoa New Zealand

Tickets vi UTR

id: THE WAYSIDE, SEISMIC STATE & DEAD CHERRY-Valhalla, Wellington-Valhalla
name: THE WAYSIDE, SEISMIC STATE & DEAD CHERRY
long_description:
The Wayside, Seismic State, and Dead Cherry at Valhalla!

Wellington rockers The Wayside, Seismic State, and Dead Cherry hit the Valhalla stage together for the first time. Individually they are electric, collectively they are not to be missed.

Bring your party attitude and your dancing shoes, this show is not to be missed!

Get your tickets now at Under The Radar, door sales also available.

The Wayside:

The Wayside's unique blues rock sound has a groove that gets the room moving. Recent New Zealand Battle of the Band's National Finalists, their high energy performances are punctuated by sick licks and soaring vocals.

Seismic State:

High-octane alt-rock with a blues-funk soul.

A staple of the New Zealand rock circuit, the Wellington quartet is known for a professional, high-energy live show. Since the release of their debut EP State of Things, which earned international airplay and a Top 58 spot on The Generator FM’s Kiwi 101, the band has consistently anchored bills at iconic venues including San Fran and Valhalla.

Their pedigree includes support slots for AMA award winners Dead Favours on their Riffing & Yelling tour, Seismic State delivers a sophisticated performance built for the big stage.

Dead Cherry:

Dead Cherry are are making waves with their high energy slice of old school rock ‘n roll, keeping it raw and real. Their debut EP Mother was released late last year.

name: MOKSHA - 5 YEAR ANNIVERSARY
long_description:
TEAM MOKSHA PRESENTS

MOKSHA -5 Year Anniversary Gathering
08 AUGUST 2026 | VALHALLA, WELLINGTON


Tickets here

Five years.

Honestly, it's hard to believe.

What started as a small dream between a few friends has grown into something far bigger than we ever imagined.

Over the last five years, we've shared dancefloors, sunsets, sunrises, laughter, hugs, friendships, and countless unforgettable moments together. We've watched strangers become friends, friends become family, and a community grow around a shared love for music, connection, and freedom.

Our recent gathering, AARANYA , reminded us once again how special this community truly is. Seeing so many beautiful souls come together, dancing under the open sky, sharing smiles and creating memories, filled our hearts with gratitude.

To every artist who has played our stages.
To every volunteer who has helped behind the scenes.
To every person who bought a ticket, shared a post, invited a friend, or danced with us until sunrise...

THANK YOU !

Team Moksha wouldn't exist without you.

As we step into our fifth year, we wanted to celebrate this milestone together.

On Saturday, 08 August, we return to Valhalla Wellington for a special anniversary gathering.

No egos.
No expectations.

Just good music, good people, and the energy that happens when our community comes together as one.

Expect a carefully curated journey through sound, immersive visuals, and the unmistakable atmosphere that has always made Moksha feel like home.

Whether you've been with us since day one or you're about to join us for your very first event, this night is for you.

Let's celebrate five years of music, friendship, growth, and community.

And let's create a few more memories together.

We can't wait to see your faces on the dancefloor again.

With love,

Team Moksha

Five years later, the music still calls us together.
Welcome home.

name: GIRLS TORQUE
long_description:
Torque Sounds are back!

Presenting our first Girls Torque here in Aotearoa. Celebrating the wāhine DJs of Te Whanganui-a-Tara. Expect quality selectors playing on the classic Torque Sounds rig that you've heard all over Pōneke and beyond.

Girls Torque is the modern revival of a night that made its mark in London rave scene back in 2004 at the legendary venue; Fridge in Brixton. Two decades on, the scene has transformed. The talent is undeniable, the ranks are deep, and the dancefloor belongs to everyone.This is not a nostalgia trip. It's a resurrection: same name, same energy, new city, new era!

On the line up we have:
M.CAP
Fortuna
Malware
Claire-voyant
Fluffcore

Kicking things off at 9pm with an assortment of electronic music to keep you dancing deep into the night!

Each of the DJ's on this lineup have their names woven into the fabric of Wellington's club scene, each making waves in their own way;

• M.Cap is the founder of 'Nine Oh Nine' who facilitate girls & Femmes only DJ workshops.
• Fortuna is the founder of 'Fortunes' known for their deep/prog/melodic house & techno events.
• Malware is the Co-founder of Venom Events who focus on Techno events here in Pōneke.
• Claire-voyant is one of the founders of Torque Sounds and the original Girls Torque event back in London.
• Fluffcore is the Co-founder of TGF known for their dark techno events.

Come and kanikani to your hearts content amongst friends Saturday August 15th at Valhalla.

Tickets available now via events.humanitix.com/girls-torque

id: STRUNG OUT (USA) WITH THE VILE MAXIM, NO SECTOR & RICKY BOBBY-Valhalla, Wellington-Valhalla
name: STRUNG OUT (USA) WITH THE VILE MAXIM, NO SECTOR & RICKY BOBBY
long_description:
STRUNG OUT (USA) RETURN FOR FULL-BLOWN NZ TOUR —PERFORMING
SUBURBANTEENAGEWASTELANDBLUES IN FULL

Tickets Available here!

Strung Out tore through NZ in 2023, and you lapped it up. You loved them, and they loved
you—so much so that they’re returning this September for a full-blown New Zealand tour, hitting
four locations across both the North and South Island.

And this time, they’re bringing something special.

To celebrate the 30th Anniversary of SUBURBANTEENAGEWASTELANDBLUES, Strung Out
will be playing the album in its entirety.

One of punk’s holy grails, it’s fast, ferocious, and
precise—a record that helped define the genre and influenced generations of bands that
followed.

Released in 1996, SUBURBANTEENAGEWASTELANDBLUES pushed the boundaries of the
genre—faster, sharper, and more intricate than anything that came before. Three decades on, it
still hits hard, and hearing it played live, front to back, is an experience no self-respecting punk
fan can miss.

Hailing from Simi Valley, California, Strung Out are long-standing punk rock royalty and one of
Fat Wreck Chords’ defining “big four.” With decades of touring under their belts, they have a
proven track record of igniting crowds and delivering high-octane, full-throttle punk shows.

Expect a night of relentless energy: razor-sharp riffs, pounding drums, and shout-along
choruses delivered with force.

This is controlled chaos at its best: sweat-soaked rooms, ringing
ears, and intensity that pulls you right in.

Last time Strung Out were here, shows sold out. This run will be no different.

Don’t sleep on it, or you’ll miss it.

name: MOVEMENT (THIRD EDITION)
long_description:
Third Edition: What We Do Is Secret

Movement presents alternative sounds of the 80s and beyond to make you move.

Your host is DJ Matai, known for sets spanning vintage goth, new wave and post-punk. Expect to hear the classic and the obscure. Not only a selector, but a genuine alternative music fanatic, he is also known for running Razored Raw and drumming in bands such as No Sector and Maced.

Joined by guests:

TV DiSKO: plumbs the deeper recesses of the globe for post-punk, dark electro, synth-pop, minimal, cold and dark wave to fill a discerning dance floor.

Coffin Nails: fresh type-A negative blood injected into the Wellington selecting scene, Coffin Nails strikes again for Movement volume 1 edition 3. Coming with them is a breadth of genres, from iconic synth pop to the early days of hiphop, all freshly exhumed from the graves of the 80s.

Brought to you with the support of Creeps Record Parlour!
